name: Arcane Storm / Arcane Storm 2 / Arcane Storm 3

values.quote: remains active as a moving storm for {{fd|6.5}} seconds

values.meaning: tick interval of the storm's damage
values.quote: striking a bolt of electricity onto enemies within it every second

values.meaning: maximum number of damage ticks (including initial hit) over the base duration
values.quote: The base duration allows for 7 strikes (including the initial one).
values.binNote: Wiki states 7 total strikes (initial burst + 6 subsequent ticks over the 6.5s duration at 1s cadence), while the bin's MaxTicks field is 6 - likely counting only the subsequent/DoT ticks and excluding the separate initial burst instance. Reporting the wiki's stated total of 7 as the count that matters for total damage dealt; the bin's 6 corresponds to the number of subsequent-tick instances.

mechanics.claim: Spell shield only blocks the initial burst damage, not the subsequent storm ticks.
mechanics.quote: Spell shield will only block the initial damage.

mechanics.claim: The singularity automatically targets and follows the nearest champion hit by the initial damage.
mechanics.quote: The singularity will target the nearest champion hit by its initial damage and will follow them.

mechanics.claim: Cooldown starts after the effect (recast/expiration), not on initial cast.
The ability can be recast at any time while the singularity is active, redirecting it.
mechanics.quote: ''Arcane Storm'' can be recast at any time while the singularity is active.
